comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
GOAL & METHOD: Minimize Gerrit Verified Gate CI runtime without weakening confidence in code that passes it. Method: hypothesis-driven, experimentally-proven attribution for every long pole; no assumptions. Authorized to instrument code and shard exploration across background subagents.

FINDINGS (Gerrit Verified Gate breakdown, ~13 min): slowest cell = pytest ubuntu-latest py3.13 (coverage + diff-cover). Experimentally assessed macOS vs Ubuntu identical-test runtime; macOS runner is the longer pole. Attributed 140 py3.14 unit-test failures to a single dominant cause: ~120 dependency-drift, ~16 PATH-artifact, 2 own-edits -> 3.14 is language/stdlib-clean when using LOCKED deps.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
APPROVED PLAN (user decisions A-E): (A) immediate impl; (B)+(C) run experiments to prove gains + no regression, impl if proven; (D) approved -> put 3.13 and 3.12 into periodic CI, use 3.14 for the gate (current Python release); (E) deferred pending post-landing need. Landed A+C first (all migrations) via contribution process and verified live; then rolled D into cybernetic-ferric-stallion with a certified plan-review attestation.

MAIN-FAILURE DEBUG (/rebar-debug): investigated reported failures on main, root-caused, landed fix(es). Then superseded the old CI ticket and wrote a new epic for further CI improvements aligned with popular/actively-maintained OSS practices without significant latency impact (research in ticket + linked research ticket + session log). Old ticket closed as supersedes (no review-plan required).

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
KEY TECHNICAL LEARNINGS (durable):
- E4 mechanism: tests/_extra_guard.py (via tests/conftest.py) converts importorskip self-skips (ui/reviewbot/pricing) into HARD ERRORS when REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1. _build-and-test.yml sets it =1 AND installs --extra dev/reviewbot/ui; S5 sweep cells install FEWER extras, so they MUST leave REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS unset. Verified code already does; S5 plan-review BLOCK on E4 was a plan-doc gap, remediated by description note + AC (not a code defect).
- Plan-review admits only descriptions <= 8000 chars (verify.max_ticket_description_chars). rebar counts ~40 chars fewer than wc -c; target wc -c <= ~8040.
- Stale-material close gate: closing an epic re-checks plan-review attestation currency; adding children (1->3) changed the fingerprint -> close failed 'stale-material'. Fix: re-run rebar review-plan <epic>, then retry close. Ticking AC checkboxes is attestation-SAFE (box state normalized out of fingerprint).
- Completion-verifier close needs a commit carrying the rebar-ticket: trailer reachable from worktree HEAD (satisfied by local commit even pre-merge).
- CLI quirks: 'rebar comment <id> "body"' is POSITIONAL; 'rebar session-log start' takes NO positional args (metadata only, then append); 'rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD'; prefix env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" on every command (worktree venv not on ambient PATH).

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body: OUTCOME & RESIDUALS: Epic COMPLETE. Full test suite consolidated onto Ubuntu for the gate; reduced compatibility sweep moved to scheduled CI against origin/main (runs periodically, not on every Gerrit change), preserving unit coverage on cheap fixtures inside the Verified Gate. CodeQL owner-decision comment posted on epic: keep scheduled/non-gating. (E) still deferred — reassess only if a residual long pole appears after these changes bed in. No further Gerrit/ticket/code actions pending. Both feature worktrees removed; all /tmp experiment artifacts and locked-dep venvs cleaned up.
